notes.title: Public Playtest 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]2.0 Update / Public Release[/h1]

Hello everyone! I am excited to announce that Presence's Play-Test is receiving its 2.0 update! This update expands the game in a whole bunch of ways. To the addition of leveling and the class tree system, to the whole new Castle Area. The game is really starting to take some shape, and I am ready for all of you to play it and give me your feedback!

This update has been announced everywhere, and so a whole host of new players will be playing the game for the first time, which is super exciting!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]

As stated before, I am looking primarily for feedback. Now, I am super excited for you all to get to enjoy the game. That is always the best part. However, the game is still in need of work, and so your feedback will be incredibly valuable.

You can give feedback through the 'Give Feedback' button on the game's homepage, as well as through the community discord.

[h1]New Game Trailer[/h1]

The first trailer for the game has been made to help showcase this play-test release. It is a simple 35s trailer, highlighting some of the new additions.

[previewyoutube=GTvRgCQ-V3E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]A Huge Thank You[/h1]

The previous Play-Test release of the game went incredibly well, and nearly all of your comments and feedback have been added to the game, helping to improve it is more ways than one. I cannot thank you all who play-test the game enough, as well as everyone who will continue to play-test or start to. Your insights and feedback are truly invaluable.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

I am ecstatic too see what you all think of the latest version of the game, as well as to hear all of your comments. Thank you all again. I will see you all in the discord, or in the next update ;) Far Travellers...

- Patrick

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It has been sometime since the release of the first Playtest version, and in that time Presence has seen some major additions and changes.

If you want to see a detailed breakdown of one of the new features on its way, be sure to check out my latest devlog on YouTube.

[previewyoutube=sHsrMfNostg;full][/previewyoutube]

There will be a few more videos releasing in the weeks to come, exploring the major additions to the game, ranging from the new leveling system to the addition of a whole new area. With new additions come testing, and so I wanted to announce that Presence's Pre Alpha Version 2.0 will be releasing on the Playtest this upcoming July 28th!

I cannot express how different the game feels, and how much more fun it is too play. With new items, 25+ skills, and 15 different classes to play around with, I am excited to see you all play the game in its new state.

However, again this is releasing on the Playtest version of the game, so I am also looking for feedback on the games systems, new and old. As well as fixing any bugs that appear in the playtest.

I can't wait for this to be in your hands. Be sure to request access for the playtest, wishlist Presence, and keep an eye out for more videos on the YouTube page.

I will be seeing you again soon, Far Travelers...

notes.title: Pre Alpha 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I can't thank you enough for all the feedback I have received from you all. It has been great seeing my game actually be played. I have been hard at work addressing your concerns and issues that you have brought up to me. This update, Version 1.1, addresses those things and even adds new content to the game. Here are the dev notes:

New Additions:
[list]
[*] Added 10+ items, most of which are new weapons.
[*] Added 5 new grids/sub-areas to the Forest.
[*] Added 3 new enemies: Underling Shadow, Underling Mage, and the Bandit Archer. The Shadow and Mage have unique abilities, giving a greater challenge.
[*] Added particle effects when looting chests to give a more rewarding and interesting feel to acquiring loot.
[*] Added more chests to various grids/sub-areas to add more chances for acquiring loot.
[*] Added more in-depth UI for items and Skills, giving more detail to what exactly they do.
[*] Added a guide to Combat Panel on the Main Menu and Exit screens.
[*] Added the 'Give Feedback' button to the Exit screen, that way people don't have to relaunch the game to access it.
[*] Added additional animations to every character in the game, allowing them to look both right and left. This also applies in combat. They also have attack animations for both left and right.
[*] Added Diagonal movement, now the Player character can move diagonally helping to ease the pain of movement.
[*] Made it so when in combat, if you only have one character, it will auto select them at the start of each turn. Helps to reduce the amount of clicking you have to do.
[*] Added sound effects for equipping a weapon, armor, and accessory. Also added sound effect for changing between inventories.
[*] Added Day and Night variation. Every time you start a run there is a 50/50 chance it will be night or day.
[*] Added two music tracks to the game. One for the general forest ambiance, and one for in combat.
[/list]

Fixed Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed a weird visual glitch on the main menu where it would look like lines were appearing between the tiles on the map. (May still not be fixed, please report if not).
[*] Fixed visual issues with trees being clipped and looking incomplete, mainly on the edge of maps.
[*] Fixed puddles from appearing over the character.
[*] Fixed chest opening animation from replaying when reentering an area after the chest had already been looted.
[*] Fixed an issue where equipping weapons would not change the characters attack range.
[*] Addressed issues with people trying to interact with the angel statue that appears in some areas. Now it is intractable, and will tell the user that it will have functionality in a future update.
[*] Fixed a bug where the user could go into enemies inventories and un-equip their equipment from them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the user's cursor in combat would not disappear if in the inventory screen, and then be duplicated.
[*] Fixed an issue where if a character in the player party dies, they still get a turn in combat. Which made it so combat never ended because you could not select the dead character.
[/list]

Known Bugs:
[list]
[*] If character has a full inventory and they open a chest, the item given by the chest will simply be deleted.
[*] Enemy range display does not update if something dies in its range.
[*] Mist Knight can teleport on top of characters, resulting in the player not being able to move that character, thus never ending combat.
[*] AI has weird behavior if they have an attack range greater than 1.
[*] Characters in combat do not visually follow the path they take, making it appear like they are moving through objects and other characters. This is just a visual glitch, in the actual code they are not doing this.
[/list]

And that is all I have for this one. Hopefully these changes and additions excite you! This will most likely be the last update to the Pre Alpha version of the game. In June 2023, Playtest 2.0 will be coming out, which will include all the major features of the game and a whole new area to explore after the forest.

Thank you again for all the support. See you in the next one Far Travellers...

notes.title: Playtest 1.0 Live now!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the support over the past year of development. Your support and patience is starting to pay off, as today I give you version 1.0 of the Presence playtest! Version Pre-Alpha 1.0 consists of the first area in the game, and has most of the major systems in the game implemented. 

The purpose of the playtest is to collect feedback from you the players. Is the game actually fun? Where does it need improvement? Any major bugs/issues? These are the sort of questions I am hoping to get answered with this early build of the game. The game is roughly 10-20 minutes in length. For feedback go to this form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfG6Ewn1dTkLonnHnjRm74iXpy0XCUgCtCrSPD9uxhhMCWygw/viewform

Or click the 'Give Feedback' button on the game's main menu. 

All and all I hope you all at least have some fun with the early build, I know its not perfect, but I hope it at least excites you for the future of the game. The playtest will be live for 1-2 weeks, after-which it will be closed and you will no longer be able to access the game. BUT, don't worry. I am planning on doing a much larger and significant playtest 2.0 in June. That version will have all the major systems ready, along with the second area. Alongside more story and lore added to the game.

Be sure to follow the devlog series on my YouTube to keep up with what I am working on.

With that, have fun. I am excited to see all your reactions and to address the issues and concerns you have.

See you in the next one, Far Travellers.
